description: Final Polish and Documentation: README, 404 page, loading states, landing page, and metadata
steps: Create comprehensive README.md in Spanish at project root
Create src/app/not-found.tsx - custom 404 page with dark theme and game-themed message
Create src/app/loading.tsx - global loading state with spinner/pulsing animation
Update src/app/page.tsx - landing page with auth check and branded design
Add metadata exports to login, CEO dashboard, and my-panel pages
acceptance_criteria: README.md is comprehensive and written in Spanish
404 page has dark theme and game-themed message with link back to home
Loading page has spinner/pulsing animation in dark theme
Landing page checks auth, redirects if authenticated, shows branded page if not
All main pages have proper metadata exports
npm run build completes without errors
verification: Run npm run build and confirm successful compilation with zero errors
findings: All files created and updated successfully. README.md written in Spanish with full project documentation. Custom 404 page uses game-themed messaging. Loading state uses ping and spin animations with dark theme. Landing page (page.tsx) is a server component that checks Supabase auth - redirects to /dashboard if authenticated, otherwise shows branded landing with feature cards and login button. Metadata added via layout.tsx for login (since it is a client component) and directly to CEO dashboard and my-panel pages. Build passes cleanly. The middleware deprecation warning is pre-existing from FEAT-001.
